name: University of Melbourne Student Bursaries
summary: One-off bursaries of $1,000 to $10,000 for University of Melbourne students in financial need, applied for in two rounds a year.
key: A one-off $1,000 to $10,000, depending on financial need.
who: Enrolled at the University of Melbourne at the round's close date, in Good Standing.
Selected on financial need. Single-subject and non-award students aren't eligible.
how: Submit the Student Financial Assessment form while a round is open.
catches: Round 1 opens 1 January and closes 8 March. Round 2 opens 1 May and closes 2 August.
One application also puts you in for smaller named awards such as the Housing Bursary.

evidence.quote: The bursaries provide a one-off payment of between $1000 to $10,000 depending on the level of financial need.
